## How *value is created*

Our value comes from intelligence, experience, and accountability working together — across every
solution we design, every technology we deliver, and every operation we optimize.

Designed around outcomes, not equipment

Every Dematic solution begins with understanding what matters most to your company and operations.

Performance, resilience, scalability, and risk guide the design from the first decision. Technology
follows intent.

[Find the right solution for you[cta-arrow]][122]

Where insight becomes direction

Dematic software connects systems, reveals patterns, and orchestrates strategies across your
operation.

It turns automation into a flexible and agile ecosystem that adapts and evolves as your business
changes — daily, seasonally, and over the years.

[Get the right insight now[cta-arrow]][123]

Value that continues long after go-live

Dematic stays engaged beyond implementation. We optimize performance, modernize systems, and protect
your investment throughout its lifecycle.

Our worldwide, 24/7 service and spare parts network supports uptime, reliability, and continuous
improvement.

[Understand lifecycle solutions and services[cta-arrow]][124]

Experience that thinks ahead

Decades of real-world experience across many industries — including retail and e-commerce,
wholesale, manufacturing, and third-party logistics — shape every recommendation we make.

Meeting the challenges of some of the world's most demanding warehouses and distribution
centers have taught our teams to understand where risk emerges, where flow breaks, and how
performance holds up under pressure.

[Explore industry expertise[cta-arrow]][125]

Efficiency *that endures*

Sustainability at Dematic is not optional, it’s foundational. It’s embedded in how systems are
designed, operated, and evolved. Safety is equally fundamental, protecting people, operations, and
performance over the entire lifecycles.

## How *value is created*

Our value comes from intelligence, experience, and accountability working together — across every
solution we design, every technology we deliver, and every operation we optimize.

Designed around outcomes, not equipment

Every Dematic solution begins with understanding what matters most to your company and operations.

Performance, resilience, scalability, and risk guide the design from the first decision. Technology
follows intent.

[Find the right solution for you[cta-arrow]][122]

Where insight becomes direction

Dematic software connects systems, reveals patterns, and orchestrates strategies across your
operation.

It turns automation into a flexible and agile ecosystem that adapts and evolves as your business
changes — daily, seasonally, and over the years.

[Get the right insight now[cta-arrow]][123]

Value that continues long after go-live

Dematic stays engaged beyond implementation. We optimize performance, modernize systems, and protect
your investment throughout its lifecycle.

Our worldwide, 24/7 service and spare parts network supports uptime, reliability, and continuous
improvement.

[Understand lifecycle solutions and services[cta-arrow]][124]

Experience that thinks ahead

Decades of real-world experience across many industries — including retail and e-commerce,
wholesale, manufacturing, and third-party logistics — shape every recommendation we make.

Meeting the challenges of some of the world's most demanding warehouses and distribution
centers have taught our teams to understand where risk emerges, where flow breaks, and how
performance holds up under pressure.

[Explore industry expertise[cta-arrow]][125]

Efficiency *that endures*

Sustainability at Dematic is not optional, it’s foundational. It’s embedded in how systems are
designed, operated, and evolved. Safety is equally fundamental, protecting people, operations, and
performance over the entire lifecycles.

FANUC started the development of NCs in 1955, and ever since, has devoted itself to focusing on
factory automation.
FANUC is active in the fields of FA, which encompasses basic technologies, consisting of NCs
(numerical controls), servos and lasers, and Robots to which such basic technologies are applied, as
well as Robomachines.

Robots and Robomachines, customers are able to use FANUC products more efficiently.
FANUC also offers service, with a policy for not terminating support of FANUC products as long as
they are used by customers.
Through such activities, FANUC contributes to the development of manufacturing industries in Japan
and overseas, by promoting automation and efficiency in customers' factories.

# Flexibility-First
# Automation

Flexible automation that adapts to demand fluctuations, workforce shifts, and evolving order

## Fully autonomous fulfillment starts with Locus Array

*A new class of Physical AI for high-performance warehouse automation.* 

Engineered to perceive, reason, and act in real time, [Locus Array
][120]executes [autonomous fulfillment][121] directly in the aisle through a Robots-to-Goods (R2G)
model. From picking and putaway to induction, drop-off, slotting, and replenishment, fulfillment
runs continuously across every shift. 

Orchestrated by LocusONE™, Locus Array executes the work that keeps fulfillment running around the
clock. Throughput stays high, storage density increases, and time to value accelerates, even when
demand shifts without warning. No rigidity. No long lead times. And none of the constraints that
come with traditional fixed automation. 

[ See How Locus Array Works ][122]
[Locus Array in aisles]

## Modern warehouse operations no longer operate in predictable cycles

Order volumes surge and soften without warning. SKU profiles evolve continuously. Labor availability
changes by shift, by role, and by location. What once could be planned months in advance now must be
managed in real time.

In this environment, the question is no longer how fast you can run. It’s whether you can keep
running when conditions shift. It requires the confidence and ability to maintain throughput,
service levels, and execution quality even as conditions change.

Locus Robotics enables scalable fulfillment automation by orchestrating people and warehouse robots
as one intelligent workforce. Our autonomous mobile robots reduce travel time, improve picking
efficiency, and help maintain throughput even during peak variability.

[ Improve Your Business ][123]

## Automation Built for Change

Traditional warehouse automation is built for predictability. Today’s operations are not.

Locus Robotics takes a different approach.

Our flexible automation model combines physical AI, real-time orchestration, and adaptive execution
to continuously rebalance work inside the warehouse. As priorities shift throughout the day,
[LocusONE][124]™ dynamically coordinates work across associates and robots to keep operations
moving.

The result is stable throughput — even when demand spikes or labor tightens.

#### Adapt Across Environments

Deploy warehouse robotics in existing facilities, multi-level operations, and evolving layouts
without costly redesigns.

#### Scale at Your Pace

Start where you need today and expand automation as volume, workflows, and business demands grow.

#### Maintain Operational Confidence

Sustain throughput and service levels despite variability in labor, demand, and order complexity.

## Flexible Fulfillment Across Core Workflows

Every warehouse faces variability — in volume, labor, inventory, and order mix. Locus Robotics
adapts across these realities by coordinating work dynamically across the most critical fulfillment
workflows.

LocusONE™ is the intelligence layer behind every Locus Robotics deployment. It applies real-time
physical AI to continuously coordinate work across people, autonomous robots, and workflows —
balancing priorities, reallocating labor, and protecting throughput as conditions change. Powered by
LocusONE’s physical AI, Locus Robotics delivers multiple automation paths designed to match
operational reality:

### Collaborative Automation

Guided by LocusONE, Locus Origin and Locus Vector work alongside associates to support picking,
transport, and fulfillment workflows across the warehouse.

[LEARN MORE][136]

### Fully Autonomous Fulfillment

With Locus Array, operations can reduce picking and putaway labor by 90%+ and introduce highly
autonomous execution where it makes sense - without rebuilding the facility or replacing existing
systems. Together, these solutions allow warehouses to automate in phases — without locking into a
single path.

From global 3PLs to enterprise retailers and healthcare distributors, organizations rely on Locus
Robotics to deliver consistent performance at scale.

* Faster onboarding when labor pools fluctuate
* Improved labor utilization across shifting workflows
* Measurable productivity gains without rigid automation

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

## One digital twin, clear operational insight

At the University of Wollongong, a digital twin brings together data from 1,000 assets, 500 BMS
points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

[Explore Building X][7]
[Amazonia rainforest]

## A digital twin in the Amazon rainforest

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

[Read the story][8]
[A person wearing a headset interacts with a holographic display of 3D models and data
visualizations.]

intelligence, simulation and smart technologies, moving you from digital blueprint to real-world
impact.

technology across processing, packaging, robotics and machine vision. We’re committed to supporting
your growth and ensuring [automation][219] is at the heart of manufacturing.

### Automated Guided Vehicle Supplier Directory Overview

Find, compare, and connect with automated guided vehicle manufacturers through a supplier directory
built to help buyers source the right automation partner for material movement, pallet transport,
cart handling, towing, and line support. This page is designed for teams that need to browse AGV
manufacturers, review AGV suppliers, and compare automated guided vehicles for warehousing,
manufacturing, automotive production, healthcare logistics, food processing, and distribution
operations. Whether you are planning a first deployment or expanding an AGV system, this directory
helps buyers quickly identify suppliers by equipment type, application focus, and operational fit.

### Forklift-Style Automated Guided Vehicles

Forklift-style automated guided vehicles are built for pallet pickup, drop-off, stacking support,
and repetitive load transfer in warehouses, factories, and shipping areas. Buyers often compare
these systems when they need automated guided vehicle manufacturers that support higher payloads,
aisle navigation, and safer material movement around workers and fixed equipment.

### Tugger and Cart-Based AGV Systems

Tugger and cart-based automated guided vehicles are used to pull trailers, move work-in-process
materials, and feed production areas on scheduled routes. These AGV vehicles are common in
manufacturing plants, automotive operations, and large assembly environments where continuous parts
flow, route repeatability, and predictable delivery timing matter.

### Unit Load Vehicles and Automated Guided Carts

Unit load vehicles and automated guided carts support tote movement, pallet transfer, and
station-to-station transport across distribution, packaging, electronics, and pharmaceutical
operations. Buyers searching AGV manufacturers and AGV companies often look at load type, routing
method, and facility layout to determine whether a standard vehicle or more specialized automated
guided vehicle system makes the most sense.

### Autonomous Guided Vehicles and AGV Robots

More advanced autonomous guided vehicle and AGV robot platforms support flexible navigation,
obstacle detection, and software-driven fleet coordination. These systems are frequently used in
facilities that want greater route adaptability, better traffic control, and easier integration with
warehouse software, manufacturing controls, and changing workflows.

### Industry Applications of AGV Systems

Automotive plants rely on automated guided vehicles to move parts, kits, and assemblies between
storage areas and production cells with predictable timing. Warehousing and distribution operations
use AGV robots for pallet transport, replenishment, and order movement across high-volume
facilities. Food and beverage processors depend on automated guided vehicle systems for repeatable
material flow in fast-paced production environments. Healthcare facilities use autonomous guided
vehicles to move supplies, carts, and support materials through controlled internal routes.
Electronics and pharmaceutical manufacturers use AGV vehicle platforms where clean handling,
accuracy, and traceable movement are essential.

### Production Volume and System Design Fit

Production volume should shape the starting point of any supplier review. Buyers comparing AGV
suppliers should define throughput, shift patterns, load frequency, and route density before
narrowing options, because a low-volume transport task and a continuous high-volume workflow require
very different system designs.

### Fixed Route vs Flexible Navigation Systems

Process type matters just as much as speed. Some operations need fixed, repeatable routes for line
feeding or pallet transfer, while others benefit from more flexible autonomous guided vehicle or AMR
manufacturers that support dynamic rerouting, variable tasks, and mixed traffic conditions.

### Integration with Existing Facility Systems

Integration planning should happen early. Buyers should ask whether an AGV system can connect with
existing conveyors, racking layouts, software controls, scanners, safety systems, and production
scheduling tools without creating bottlenecks or forcing major floor changes.

### Compliance, Safety, and Documentation Requirements

Inspection, documentation, and compliance review should also be part of vendor evaluation.
Facilities in regulated or quality-sensitive industries often need suppliers that can support
validation requirements, safety documentation, testing standards, and clear maintenance practices
alongside the equipment itself.

### Choosing the Right AGV Manufacturer

Supplier specialization can separate a workable project from an expensive mismatch. When reviewing
AGV manufacturers, AGV companies, AMR companies, or AMR robot companies, buyers should compare
application experience, payload focus, navigation approach, support responsiveness, and ability to
scale from one vehicle to a larger fleet.

validation requirements, safety documentation, testing standards, and clear maintenance practices
alongside the equipment itself.

### Choosing the Right AGV Manufacturer

Supplier specialization can separate a workable project from an expensive mismatch. When reviewing
AGV manufacturers, AGV companies, AMR companies, or AMR robot companies, buyers should compare
application experience, payload focus, navigation approach, support responsiveness, and ability to
scale from one vehicle to a larger fleet.

## Work smarter, with Intelligent Fulfillment.

AutoStore combines an [industry leading storage system][136] with intelligent software that actively
improves how your warehouse performs every single day.

Behind the scenes, [CubeVerse™][137] is the software foundation that connects initial design,
simulation, operations, and predictive diagnosis into one unified platform.

Built into it, AutoStore Intelligence™ uses 15 TB of operational and simulation data to optimize
performance, predict issues before they disrupt operations, and unlock capacity you did not know you
had.

The result is a warehouse that does not just run. It evolves. Higher throughput. Fewer disruptions.
Lower total cost of ownership. And a clear, confident step closer to lights-out fulfillment.

AutoStore Intelligence is AutoStore’s AI-driven optimization layer embedded across the entire
AutoStore lifecycle.  

Powered by 20+ proprietary AI models and agents trained on more than 15 TB of operational and
simulation data, it optimizes your system performance to extract maximum throughput from the
infrastructure you already have.

It identifies performance constraints, anticipates issues before they disrupt operations, and turns
complex system data into clear, actionable guidance.

New AI capabilities are continuously introduced within CubeVerse to further enhance operational
performance over time.

## Built for High-Throughput Efficiency

The AutoStore warehouse automation system is the pinnacle of speed, density, and accuracy for
e-commerce and 3PL giants. Our system, the world’s fastest goods-to-person solution, optimizes every
robotic route for peak throughput. The modular cube design fits any space, quadrupling capacity and
boasting a 99.8% uptime.

With rapid order processing and full SKU access, AutoStore seamlessly scales with your growth,
powered by cutting-edge tech and analytics for a streamlined, error-free operation. The engine of
high-throughput fulfillment, AutoStore supercharges your warehouse.

[ [Turbocharge your order fulfillment →] ][146]
[HP THC image]

## High Demands, Big Results

The world’s largest and fastest retailers use AutoStore for incredible speed, precision, accuracy &
reliability. Results speak for themselves:

## Pallet Rack Safety is an Ecosystem
## Most vendors solve only one part of the problem

[[Pallet Rack Safety Program Flywheel]][173]

Damotech brings [repair][174], [protection][175], [inspection][176], [training][177], and
[software][178] together into one continuous rack safety ecosystem. We connect the entire rack
safety lifecycle with engineering-led expertise, broad North American coverage, and the speed to act
when damage or risk cannot wait.

Whether you manage a single facility or a national network, Damotech helps reduce downtime, close
safety gaps, and simplify rack safety at scale — with a clear path to faster ROI.

[Rack Repair Kit][179]

### [DAMO PRO][180]

The DAMO PRO is the best pallet rack repair kit on the market, bar none. It repairs damaged uprights
and protects against future impact — and comes with a lifetime warranty against impact!
[DAMO PRO INFO][181]
[[DamoPRO Pallet Rack Repair Kit]][182]

[Building Column Protection][183]

### [DAMO BOLLARD][184]

The 42" tall DAMO BOLLARD protects doorways, dock doors, and other high-traffic points from forklift
and vehicle impact. Built from heavy-duty 6" x 6" steel and anchored to an oversized 10" x 10" base,
it transfers impact energy into the floor slab instead of the equipment or structure behind it,
preventing costly repairs and downtime.
[DAMO BOLLARD INFO][185]
[[DAMO-Bollard-500x]][186]

[Rack Column Protection][187]

### [DAMO GUARD][188]

The DAMO GUARD is your first line of defense against forklift and pallet impact. Use the guard to
protect the base of your rack columns efficiently and cost-effectively.
[DAMO GUARD INFO][189]
[[DamotechGuard pallet rack protection guard]][190]

[Building Column Protection][191]

### [DAMO SHIELD][192]

The DAMO SHIELD protects warehouse and garage building columns. Solidly anchored to the ground, it's
the only solution on the market to be structurally independent of your building columns, thus
preventing costly repairs when impact occurs.
[DAMO SHIELD INFO][193]

## Pallet Rack Safety is an Ecosystem
## Most vendors solve only one part of the problem

[[Pallet Rack Safety Program Flywheel]][173]

Damotech brings [repair][174], [protection][175], [inspection][176], [training][177], and
[software][178] together into one continuous rack safety ecosystem. We connect the entire rack
safety lifecycle with engineering-led expertise, broad North American coverage, and the speed to act
when damage or risk cannot wait.

Whether you manage a single facility or a national network, Damotech helps reduce downtime, close
safety gaps, and simplify rack safety at scale — with a clear path to faster ROI.

[Rack Repair Kit][179]

### [DAMO PRO][180]

The DAMO PRO is the best pallet rack repair kit on the market, bar none. It repairs damaged uprights
and protects against future impact — and comes with a lifetime warranty against impact!
[DAMO PRO INFO][181]
[[DamoPRO Pallet Rack Repair Kit]][182]

[Building Column Protection][183]

### [DAMO BOLLARD][184]

The 42" tall DAMO BOLLARD protects doorways, dock doors, and other high-traffic points from forklift
and vehicle impact. Built from heavy-duty 6" x 6" steel and anchored to an oversized 10" x 10" base,
it transfers impact energy into the floor slab instead of the equipment or structure behind it,
preventing costly repairs and downtime.
[DAMO BOLLARD INFO][185]
[[DAMO-Bollard-500x]][186]

[Rack Column Protection][187]

### [DAMO GUARD][188]

The DAMO GUARD is your first line of defense against forklift and pallet impact. Use the guard to
protect the base of your rack columns efficiently and cost-effectively.
[DAMO GUARD INFO][189]
[[DamotechGuard pallet rack protection guard]][190]

[Building Column Protection][191]

### [DAMO SHIELD][192]

The DAMO SHIELD protects warehouse and garage building columns. Solidly anchored to the ground, it's
the only solution on the market to be structurally independent of your building columns, thus
preventing costly repairs when impact occurs.
[DAMO SHIELD INFO][193]

manufacture pallet [rack repair][217] and [protection][218] systems, perform [rack inspections][219]
and [load capacity calculations][220], provide [employee safety training][221], and offer an [online

company in North America.

Choosing Damotech means working with the most trusted company in warehouse and rack safety. That’s

## CRX-10*i*A/L Paint

The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the perfect industrial solution for manufacturers new to robotics.
This product line includes the CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot, which precisely dispenses materials for
uniform and reliable application in the paint, liquid and powder coatings, and fiberglass
industries. The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the first and only cobot certified for painting in
accordance with U.S. safety standards and is the best option on the market for precision dispensing
applications.

[ CRX-10iA/L Paint ][134]

## FANUC Accelerates Physical AI in Industrial Robotics, Leveraging NVIDIA Technologies

FANUC is combining its global leadership in robotics with NVIDIA’s AI computing and simulation
platforms to deliver intelligent and adaptable automation. This collaboration integrates ROBOGUIDE
with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to create photorealistic digital twins, and enables robots to
interpret voice commands and automatically generate code.

industries. The CRX-10iA/L Paint cobot is the first and only cobot certified for painting in
accordance with U.S. safety standards and is the best option on the market for precision dispensing
applications.

[ CRX-10iA/L Paint ][134]
Collaboration

## FANUC Accelerates Physical AI in Industrial Robotics, Leveraging NVIDIA Technologies

FANUC is combining its global leadership in robotics with NVIDIA’s AI computing and simulation
platforms to deliver intelligent and adaptable automation. This collaboration integrates ROBOGUIDE
with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Omniverse to create photorealistic digital twins, and enables robots to
interpret voice commands and automatically generate code.

[ Read the Announcement ][135]
In collaboration with
[Nvidia logo horiz blk]
[Image 800x600]

## Results in the Real World

[Case Studies][136]
[Thogus RTSS Feature Image]
Case Study

### [ 25% Increased Output: How Thogus Transformed Helmet Production with Robotic Drilling ][137]

Thogus eliminated a production bottleneck, increased output by up to 25% and improved manufacturing
flexibility with a custom robotic drilling system powered by FANUC robots.

[M 10i D 12 Machine Tending]
Case Study

### [ Achieving Zero-Defect Aerospace Manufacturing with Automated Grinding and Inspection ][138]

Pointe Precision machines mission‑critical aerospace parts with ultra‑tight tolerances. To ensure
flawless, scalable precision, they use automation where failure isn’t an option.

[M 710i C 45 M Sanding]
Case Study

### [ Reducing Sanding Time by 50%: RC Industries Uses Automation to Improve Finish Quality ][139]

RC Industries improved finish consistency and reduced manual sanding strain by implementing an
automated solution with Complete Solution Robotics and Notre Dame’s iNDustry Lab.

[I2T SCARA Inspection Cell]
Case Study

### [ Over 10 Times Higher Throughput Achieved Through Automated Inspection ][140]

BelleFlex boosted production 10x by automating disc spring inspection with FANUC robots — replacing
slow, inconsistent manual checks with fast, precise, and reliable quality control.

## Optimize your operations for today and for what's ahead

When supply chain disruption is the norm and customer demands are multiplying by the minute, you
need a partner to deliver cutting-edge tech and innovative thinking to predict your needs before
they become issues. We empower supply chain managers and executives to transform their manual tasks
and processes into highly efficient material handling and warehouse fulfillment solutions.

Strategy

We take a holistic approach to distribution strategy, considering upstream/downstream impacts on an
entire network of operations through close collaboration with your executive team. We start the
process with data collection and use comprehensive, proprietary science-backed tools and algorithms
to develop a network strategy that meets or exceeds your cost, service and performance objectives.

[Explore Strategy ][98]
Assessments

Improving the flexibility and efficiency of your operations starts by identifying and prioritizing
opportunities for improvement. We dive in with an in-depth assessment of your operations and network
to identify both short- and long-term opportunities for improvement. Whether you want to enhance
digital capabilities, optimize existing operations or increase resilience, the experts at FORTNA can
help.

[Explore Assessments ][99]
Operations design

Our Operations Design Methodology is rooted in Data Science. The FORTNA proven proprietary modeling
tools and algorithms allow us to design for maximum efficiency and outcomes. Our unique solution
approach allows for a truly innovative design that leverages best-fit technologies. Our intelligent
software, FORTNA WES™, optimizes the design for higher utilization of people, process, space and
supply chain automation.

[Explore Design ][100]
Implementation

We don’t just design the right solution—we help you build it. Our integrated automated material
handling solution design and engineering process ensure that all facets of implementation are fully
aligned, helping you mitigate risk with a single accountable partner while delivering solutions on
time, on-budget and with the fastest time to benefit.

[Explore Implementation ][101]
Lifecycle performance services

Keeping your operations running and in sync with changes in the business and technology is critical
to long-term success after Go-Live. FORTNA supports a diverse portfolio of material handling
equipment (MHE) and software implementations worldwide. We extend the life and performance of your
system by providing ongoing services and support to ensure maximum uptime, reduced operational
costs, safety enhancements, and upgrades and modernizations for systems and technology.

[Lifecycle Services ][102]

## ist jetzt

Wir freuen uns, mitteilen zu dürfen, dass intomarkets jetzt Teil von ameo ist!
Dein Vorteil:  Gebündelte Expertise im Amazon-Marketing, umfassendere Services, innovativere
Strategien und noch mehr Power für nachhaltiges E-Commerce-Wachstum.

**Was bedeutet das konkret?**

## ERWEITERTES Portfolio

Bewährte Leistungen werden ergänzt durch DSP, Prime Video Ads, AMC Cases, Data & Analytics,
Prozessdigitalisierung, Softwareentwicklung und vieles mehr – für ganzheitliche Strategien,
messbaren Erfolg, stärkere Ergebnissen und noch mehr Möglichkeiten für erfolgreiches Marketing.

## Mehr Spezialisten, mehr Erfahrung

Ein erweitertes Netzwerk an Spezialisten mit tiefem Branchenwissen ermöglicht maßgeschneiderte
Lösungen und sorgt für schnelle, präzise Umsetzung von Projekten. Kurz gesagt: Ein stärkeres
Expertenteam für jede Herausforderung!

## Innovation & Stabilität

Technologische Stärke gepaart mit Power und Erfahrung treiben Innovationen voran und sichern
zukunftsfähige, stabile Lösungen, die auch langfristig Bestand haben.

# Linde Material Handling

### Productivity

Efficient forklift trucks are the backbone of efficient intra-company logistics. Together with
intelligent software and comprehensive service packages, operators achieve lasting competitive
advantages.

[ More details here ][205]

### Safety

The safety of people, trucks, and goods is the central idea of Linde Material Handling’s Zero
Accident Philosophy. With integrated solutions, Linde is working toward a future of safer
intralogistics.

[ More details here ][206]

### Ergonomics

The best solutions arise when humans and technology work together in perfect harmony. The principle
of ergonomic design therefore strongly informs Linde Material Handling’s development of trucks and
services.

[ More details here ][207]
[
[Linde Material Handling employee in a warehouse with a red LED symbol of a gear wheel in the
background.]
][208]

### [Intralogistics and Automation][209]

Comprehensive solutions for intralogistics and automation from Linde Material Handling: efficient
and scalable. For greater productivity, flexibility, and safety in the warehouse.

KDL, one of Belgium’s leading logistics service providers, is equipping its brand-new 18,000 m²
warehouse in the Lokeren logistics corridor near Antwerp with a high-performance automated storage
and retrieval system (ASRS) from Movu Robotics.

3PLs need to closely collaborate with leading robotics manufacturers to scale and flex. This means
establishing a partnership with a supplier of automated and robotics systems to integrate the best
technologies tailored for 3PL and end-customer needs.

Cold storage environments present unique challenges due to extreme temperatures, which can impact

are increasingly capable of addressing these challenges effectively.

are increasingly capable of addressing these challenges effectively.

**Physical AI** built for the real world

who
we are

## We build the brain for physical work

We’re an applied AI company focused on Physical AI –foundation models that connect perception,
reasoning, and control to drive physical action. Our architecture fuses vision, language, and motion
planning so the same “brain” can operate different embodiments: arms, mobile manipulators,
humanoids, and the tools they use.

We design for the messy, unpredictable world – where safety, latency, and uptime are not side notes
but the product itself.

Mission
Make embodied intelligence practical, safe, and scalable across industries.
how we work
* **Co-develop with operators. ** We embed where work happens - factory floors, warehouses,
  backrooms
* **Iterate in the loop. ** Deploy, measure, improve  -  weekly
* **Open interfaces.** Bring your robots, fleet, or digital stack. We integrate via standard APIs
  and middleware
What makes us different
* **Reality-first learning.** We prioritize field data and operator feedback over lab-only results
* **Cross-embodiment generalization.** One model learns across robots and workflows
* **Tool use and planning.** Agents can reason, plan, and call external systems to finish multi-step
  jobs
* **Production mindset.** Reliability, safety, and uptime are part of the model’s DNA.
where we focus (today)
* **Intralogistics **(pick / pack / sort / kitting)
* **Light manufacturing & QA **
* **Retail back-of-house automation**
roadmap (select highlights)
* **Dexterity under uncertainty** (crumpled, deformable, reflective items)
* **Multi-tool, multi-step workflows **
* **Verified safety for human-robot collaboration**

our
brain

## one model, many bodies

Our foundation model is a generalist “brain” for the physical world. It fuses vision, language, and
action to understand scenes, select skills, and execute—on robotic arms, cobots, AMRs, or mixed
cells.
Train once, deploy broadly, learn continuously

safety, always on
Risk-aware planning, torque limits, safe zones, and simulation before action. Every decision is
logged for audit and improvement.

[see the architecture one-pager][3]

why it generalizes
Diverse training across items, lighting, fixtures, and failure modes— plus domain randomization and
online adaptation. That’s how the same model handles taped boxes today and shrink-wrapped totes
tomorrow.

[explore supported hardware][4]

ops & sustainability
Adapters for leading arms, grippers, sensors, and WMS/MES. Metrics that matter: successful picks,
gentle-handling rate, recovery time, energy per cycle—driving less waste and lower costs.

[talk to an engineer][5]

## inside the stack

**Perception Core: **Multi-camera vision + tactile/force cues for objects, poses, and material
properties—
even in glare, clutter, or motion.

**Skill library: **grasp, re-grasp, place, sort, verify, recover — composed on the fly instead of
brittle scripts.

**Policy engine: **goal-conditioned control with uncertainty modeling; if confidence dips, it slows,
re-plans,
or asks for help.

**Language interface: **set goals in plain language (“induct fragile polybags to lane 3”) with
guardrails
that turn intent into safe actions.

**fleet learning: **privacy-preserving updates; every site benefits from global experience without
sharing what shouldn’t be shared.

## building the future of helpful robots

We advance Physical AI that serves people and industry — responsibly and at scale. For media,
analysts, and event organizers, we offer briefings, facility visits, and on-the-record commentary.

## Request a simulation

Would you like to know how many AGVs your operations would require in order to automate your
processes and how they would navigate through your facility? Our experts can help determine these
details using our advanced simulation tool.  

Contact us at [[email protected]][66] and provide us with a DWG (warehouse drawing file) that
identifies the material flow, including pick-up locations, destinations and type of pick-up and
drop-off locations (e.g., floor, rack, conveyor). With this information, along with the load unit
specifications and the number of required movements per hour, our experts can provide a simulation
in no time with the possibility of a virtual meeting to discuss the results.

[software][57] and [Life Cycle Services][58] are there to ensure that you reduce your material

services from [AGVs][60] and [manually operated forklifts][61] to [racking][62], [AGV system
software][63] and intralogistics consultation. Each solution is designed to optimally serve your
specific intralogistics processes. When choosing our complete solution, you can have it all from the
same provider while saving time and resources.

[Logisnext Solutions ][64]

## Recoup your investment in 1–2 years

Rocla AGV Solutions have a proven record of excellent return on investment. Our clients can recoup
their investments in as little as a year. Try our calculator and see how your company’s investment
could pay off.

[Calculate your ROI ][65]

## Request a simulation

Would you like to know how many AGVs your operations would require in order to automate your
processes and how they would navigate through your facility? Our experts can help determine these
details using our advanced simulation tool.  

Contact us at [[email protected]][66] and provide us with a DWG (warehouse drawing file) that
identifies the material flow, including pick-up locations, destinations and type of pick-up and
drop-off locations (e.g., floor, rack, conveyor). With this information, along with the load unit
specifications and the number of required movements per hour, our experts can provide a simulation
in no time with the possibility of a virtual meeting to discuss the results.

**How to Find Your Equipment Model Number.**

 

Finding the right parts for your equipment is easy when you have your model and serial number which
can be found on the data plate. Luckily, a forklift data plate is installed on every truck on the
market to help you understand what your forklift can do and provide vital information.

 

**Model Number: **The model number of your toyota forklift is extremely important for relaying
information to your dealers about repair or technical assistance and for looking up replacements
part!

 

**Serial Number: **The serial number on your lift is the most important number.The model serial
number combination will allow us to provide you with the parts that will fit your particular piece
of equipment.

# The Right Forklift for Your Business is Waiting

Every operation is unique, and your forklift is no different. At Toyota, we can help you find the
right equipment to fit your specific needs. Whether you’re moving pallets through a warehouse,
navigating narrow aisles, or hauling lumber outdoors, we’ll help match you to the best Toyota
forklift for the job.  

[ Find Your Forklift ][112]

# Optimized for Peak Warehouse Productivity

The next evolution of the Toyota Stand-Up Rider Forklift is here. With enhanced ergonomics,
integrated MyInsights® telematics, and proven dock-to-stock efficiency, it delivers consistent
performance for demanding operations. Built to maximize throughput in tight spaces, it helps you get
more out of every shift.

[ Learn More ][113]

# Stay Ahead with Faster Lead Times

Toyota’s Mid IC Pneumatic Forklift is engineered with power and durability in mind to help you
tackle demanding material handling applications. Designed for outdoor environments and heavy loads,
this forklift delivers the performance you need to handle tough jobs with confidence in just **6-10
weeks**. Partner with Toyota to take your operation to the next level.

[ Learn More ][114]

# Maximize Uptime with MyToyota Fleet Management

Maximize operational efficiency in MyToyota with instant access to operating and repair manuals, a
model-specific parts catalog, easy ordering, and seamless maintenance. Gain the tools you need to
reduce downtime and keep your fleet running at peak performance. 

[ Learn More ][115]

# Power That Keeps You Moving

Built for demanding operations, Toyota’s Lithium-ion Batteries deliver consistent performance shift
after shift. Enjoy faster charging, extended runtime, and the confidence that comes with a
maintenance-free design, all supported by Toyota’s proven dependability and expert service network. 

[ Explore Lithium Options ][116]

# WAREHOUSE ROBOTICS SYSTEMS

### With an ROI of 18 months or less, it is time to stop thinking about automation. It is time to
### get it done.

You’ve heard people say warehouse robotics…warehouse automation…or even automated systems. No matter
what you call it, these advanced technology solutions can automate tasks within your warehouse or
distribution center, supplementing the work of your existing staff.

Every day, you’re coping with small budgets, tight timelines, limited staffing and the threat of
constantly growing consumer demands.

If you need help automating one of these functions, use the button below to contact one of our
consultants.

###### [Contact One of Our Consultants][5]

### **Robotic Picking Systems**

Automate the picking process by using robotic arms with grippers or suction cups to pick and place
products from shelves or bins. These features can be integrated with vision systems to identify and
locate items accurately.

 

### **Automated Storage & Retrieval Systems (AS/RS)**

Use automated, robotic shuttles to store and retrieve pallets from racking systems. These systems
leverage your vertical space to enable efficient and accurate inventory management in considerably
less floor space.

#### **An AS/RS requires 66% less labor to operate.**

###### [Learn More][6]

 

### **Robotic Sorting Systems**

Automate the sorting and diverting of items using robotic arms or conveyors that can identify and
sort into bins or containers.

### **Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs)**

AGVs are autonomous, mobile robotic platforms that autonomously navigate through the warehouse to
transport goods and pallets from one location to another. They follow predetermined paths or use
sensors with mapping technologies to safely navigate in dynamic environments.

### **Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs)**

AMRs are versatile robotic platforms that can transport goods, pick items from shelves and
collaborate with human workers. AMRs can utilize sensors, cameras and artificial intelligence
algorithms to navigate their surroundings.

### **Warehouse Drone Systems**

Drones equipped with cameras and sensors can perform inventory tracking, aerial inspections and even
monitor warehouse operations. They provide real-time data for analysis and better decision-making.

### **Collaborative Robots (Cobots)**

Cobots can perform heavy lifting, repetitive tasks or assist in order fulfillment processes, while
ensuring safe interaction with human operators.

##### When properly implemented, warehouse robotic systems can increase efficiency and accuracy,
##### reduce labor costs, improve safety, and even improve space utilization. But there is a lot
##### more to consider than just the costs.

  ###### other automated solutions][7]

  ###### consider before you automate][8]

Cobots can perform heavy lifting, repetitive tasks or assist in order fulfillment processes, while
ensuring safe interaction with human operators.
